claim_boundary: Selected common reset P0 extraction and validation only; no candidate, behavior, score, model, OIA, or real environment action.

content_validation.frame_png: nonempty regular file with PNG signature
content_validation.metadata: UTF-8 JSON object with RESET action_input, unique integer available_actions, and step_index zero

read_boundary.allowed_payloads: Exactly initial_frame.png, initial_frame.txt, and initial_metadata.json for level_01_attempt_01 under su15 in each of the five frozen run roots.
read_boundary.forbidden_payloads: Every nonselected archive member, including candidate programs, later observations, traces, logs, reasoning, session state, and scores.

required_result: All five copies of each filename are byte-identical; otherwise stop without choosing a canonical P0.
